verdict.rationale: The GPU ships with an official software ecosystem (NVIDIA app, Project G-Assist, CUDA toolkit), so an official MCP server for agent control or querying is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents one: G-Assist is NVIDIA's own built-in assistant, not an MCP server that other agents can connect to. The developer portal's llms.txt file is adjacent AI-readable documentation, not an MCP endpoint.
